freeze_preconditions: P2-P3 methodological review completed and recorded
Pilot runtime, errors, sampler settings and final replicate precision reviewed without selecting favorable outcomes
Final protocol, all run identities and full paired scenario list committed before final execution
scientific_question: Which preprocessing/model assumptions affect recovery and which gates detect predeclared failure controls beyond sampler convergence?
hypotheses: Exposure integration can materially change transit geometry and uncertainty at 1765 s exposures.
Ignoring inter-segment offsets can distort physical inference; sampler convergence alone need not reject this misspecification.
Ignoring true additional white jitter can understate uncertainty or impair predictive adequacy.
An excessively informative wrong radius prior can dominate inference despite superficially regular sampling.
Corrupted input identity must fail before sampling; under-sampling should fail numerical gates.
A predeclared unmodeled deterministic sinusoid may yield sampler-pass but predictive/scientific-fail outcomes; this is investigated, not guaranteed.

paired_designs.pairing_rule: Generate both variants with the same pair_id/replicate generation seed. Only deterministic systematic differs; measurement and jitter arrays remain identical.

normalization.truth_usage: None. The known segment offsets are never supplied to normalization or inference.
normalization.uncertainty_policy: Flux and measured flux errors are divided by the same estimated median. Median estimation uncertainty is not separately propagated by M5; retain this as a limitation common to the controls.
normalization.metadata_policy: Persist estimated median/count per group, mask, source/output hashes and method in preprocessing.json. Mark global-normalized input honestly; report numerical/PPC effects separately from policy rejection.

inference.known_design_assumptions: Known period/time convention/exposures and supplied measurement errors only; no fitted injected parameter supplies a prior, initialization or normalization factor.
inference.likelihood: Independent Normal observations, physical exposure-integrated quadratic limb-darkened transit plus Normal baseline; measured variance plus inferred white jitter variance.

derived.depth: r^2 geometric area ratio, not limb-darkened observed depth
derived.duration: Circular first-to-fourth contact duration before exposure smearing

global_normalization.changed_factor: global instead of per-segment empirical OOT scale

strong_wrong_radius_prior.label: deliberately pathological negative control, not a plausible sensitivity profile

deterministic_sine.changed_factor: add predeclared deterministic sinusoid in the generator, not stochastic correlated noise

replication_plan.precision_note: Ten pairs prioritize large intervention effect estimates; a binomial frequency near 0.5 has SE about 0.158 and 0/10 events has a Wilson 95% upper bound about 0.278. This is not a precise gate-error or calibration study; report Wilson intervals and rely on larger P2 batches for coverage. Final count needs pre-result cost justification.
replication_plan.pilot_policy: Separate pilot protocol/IDs; retain every pilot but exclude them from final effect/coverage/failure estimates. No seed chosen by outcomes.

seed_policy.inference_and_predictive: deterministic_seed(PUB-04,pair_id + '_' + variant_id,replicate_id,stream=inference|predictive); one declared attempt, no posterior draw reuse
seed_policy.replicate_id_format: rep_0000 through rep_0009 if the draft count is retained
seed_policy.run_id: final_001 only after freeze and committed registry declaration
seed_policy.retry_policy: No retries into an existing attempt. Infrastructure failures are preserved; any new attempt requires an amendment and new run identity.

primary_metrics: Paired posterior mean and median shifts in r, geometric depth, b, a, t0, full duration and jitter
Paired radius shift standardized by baseline posterior SD; descriptive, not an independent-sample test
Paired 94% interval-width ratio and SD ratio
Separate provenance, sampler, PPC, scientific-scale and final-interpretability gate outcomes
Count/fraction of sampler-pass but PPC/scientific-fail attempts
Presampling rejection rates for each invalid-identity control
secondary_metrics: Bias, absolute/relative bias, RMSE and 50/80/94 equal-tailed coverage by variant; descriptive with finite-replicate uncertainty
Residual RMSE/standardized scale and cadence-contiguous residual correlations
Sampler R-hat, ESS bulk/tail, divergences, BFMI, tree-depth warnings
Wall time and parameter uncertainty width
Data-known-control detection sensitivity and nominal-control rejection rates

diagnostic_rules.provenance: Exact input SHA-256, synthetic identity bound to bytes, expected_dataset_id match, required finite columns, segment and positive exposure/error metadata
diagnostic_rules.ppc: Frozen inherited M5 coverage/standardized residual-scale rules plus publication within-segment cadence-contiguous residual autocorrelation check over lags 1-5, Bonferroni normal-reference familywise alpha=.01. This residual reference is approximate after fitting and preprocessing; assess its rejection rate empirically.
diagnostic_rules.scientific_scale: Retain inherited M5 radius review range/jitter scale/preprocessing checks and their original thresholds. Do not relabel the radius review interval as prior support.
diagnostic_rules.gate_reporting: Never replace unavailable downstream checks after presampling rejection with empirically evaluated failures. Report null/unavailable plus failure_stage. Decompose scientific-scale reasons from inherited gate and final interpretability from publication gates.

inclusion: Every declared variant and replicate, irrespective of convergence, posterior agreement, prior domination or apparent visual quality.
exclusion: None based on results. A demonstrable implementation/protocol bug invalidates affected evidence only through a documented amendment; original attempts remain visible.
missing_failed_policy: All declared attempts enter attempted/gate-rate denominators. Paired posterior effects require both numerical posterior summaries and list unavailable pairs explicitly; never silently treat incomplete pairs as zero effect. Show all-numerically-available and both-gates-passed summaries separately.

statistical_analysis.pairing_unit: Independent generated realization identified by pair_id and replicate_id
statistical_analysis.effect_summary: All replicate-level effects, paired mean/median and empirical distribution; no best-run exemplar selection. Report Monte Carlo uncertainty from posterior draws separately from across-replicate variation.
statistical_analysis.rate_uncertainty: Wilson 95% binomial intervals with attempted denominators; pair-complete effect summaries identify their own denominator.
statistical_analysis.false_positive_definition: Invalid rejection by the deterministic provenance check on correct identity is a genuine provenance false positive. On nominal white-noise controls, sampler-pass but PPC rejection is a nominal-control rejection proxy, not an exact Type-I error guarantee because empirical normalization and fitted residuals alter the reference distribution.
statistical_analysis.false_negative_definition: A corrupted-identity input accepted for sampling is a provenance false negative. Failure to flag the deliberately injected deterministic temporal control is detection non-rejection, reported with quantitative distortion; exposure/no-jitter/strong-prior acceptance alone is not called a false negative unless the predeclared truth-based performance criterion also fails.
statistical_analysis.truth_based_performance_flag: Post hoc evaluation only: posterior mean of r differs from truth by >10% AND the 94% equal-tailed interval excludes truth. Report its joint occurrence with scientific gate acceptance; do not use truth to change inference or observational gates.
statistical_analysis.coverage_caveat: A single 94% interval miss is not itself proof of an invalid inference; expected noncoverage and low replicate precision must be explicit.
statistical_analysis.multiple_comparisons: Predeclared descriptive effects and interval estimates, no post-selected primary outcome or universal significance claim.
statistical_analysis.model_comparison: No LOO/WAIC ranking is a primary outcome; no formal ranking without matched likelihood/observations and acceptable Pareto-k diagnostics.

figures: sampler-pass PPC/scientific-fail control traces/residuals with deterministic first-eligible selection rule or all replicates
planned_outputs.lineage: Aggregate lists every registry declared_run_paths and every result_source_sha256, plus source hashes for all derived tables/figures.

interpretation_rules: Removing a component only supports its practical importance when the paired effect or validity change is quantified, not because the feature exists.
No observed sampler-pass/PPC-fail case means the planned empirical demonstration was not achieved; do not change the sinusoid, seed or thresholds to manufacture one after freezing.

A sampler-pass/PPC-fail realization supports convergence-not-sufficient only if provenance and diagnostics are correctly recorded; do not present a prior-dominated or nonconverged run as that demonstration.
Negative controls are successful tests when they expose the declared failure, not when the science gate passes.
P4 remains draft and cannot support final claims until all freeze and execution criteria are met.
invalidation_conditions: truth leakage into inference or normalization
unrecorded input mismatch outside a declared identity control
missing declared attempts hidden from aggregates
